verdict.rationale: Bolna's own docs say webhooks can be configured on the agent analytics tab to push call data to your CRM from every call, so outbound HTTP callbacks are a first-party capability. The evidence is a single summary line and gives no detail on what you can subscribe to or how. Missing for 10: documented event types/subscription granularity, webhook registration API or payload schema, delivery guarantees (retries, signing), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Configure webhooks, call summaries, and extractions for Bolna Voice AI. Push data to your CRM from every call.
